dateAssessment: The working date is March 21, 1749 from YAML. The current year 1749 is spoken at u0460–u0469; month and day are inherited. The time extraction matches a single afternoon-to-evening day, with zero calendar transitions. Ancestral memories are a separate historical frame. The short rest is credited within the camp conversations. The two-week stay and onward journey at u2463–u2484 remain future plans; the midnight comment there is table wrap-up. Jotha’s historical displacement claim does not extend the adventure interval.

watches.summary: Wellby enters ancestral memories from before Drankor; the vision supplies no adventure-clock duration.
Afternoon arrival; conversations at 2:30 p.m., with short-rest credit completed before the roughly 4 p.m. reunion.
After the 4 p.m. reunion, Wellby flies outward for fifteen minutes; return duration is unstated.
Camp evacuation takes about half an hour, after scouting and before the sunset ambush.
Sunset and twilight at the ambush; the sun is fully set by the return to the ship.
